title: obsidian ui
brief: ObsidianUI is a React and Tailwind CSS component library with an emphasis on motion — featured components and interactive effects you can preview, read the source of, and try directly in your project. From @athrix_codes; a customizable starting point for interfaces where the details matter.
details: ObsidianUI is a React and Tailwind CSS component library with an emphasis on motion — featured components plus cursor and scroll effects you can preview, read the source of, and try directly in your project. The intended flow is deliberately simple: preview it, read the code, drop it into your build, then customize styling and behavior to fit the interface you are actually shipping. Positioned for people who want a customizable starting point for expressive interfaces rather than rebuilding every interaction. From @athrix_codes.
